rows.label: Brakk Blueprint
rows.note: 12.5% per Vem Tabook kill, the bottleneck

conditions: They can spawn only in the first 5 minutes of a mission. Time it with the P key, and stand at extract after the objective.
Stalker, his death mark and negative-standing syndicate death squads override the spawn slot. Set syndicate standing to neutral first.
No spawns in Assassination, Syndicate, Arena, Sortie, Archimedea, Landscape, Archwing or Empyrean missions. Clem's weekly mission spawns one member that drops nothing.
Being captured fails the mission and attaches a Grustrag Bolt until you craft the free Bolt Release from the inbox.
Parts are untradeable, so every part is farmed yourself.
bonuses: Nekros with Desecrate is the standard drop multiplier. Squad mates with the mark raise the spawn chance, and everyone can loot.

disclosures.title: spawn odds are unconfirmed
disclosures.body: Players estimate about 1.5% plus 0.5% per marked player per mission, about 2% solo. The wiki says the Three roll every 10 seconds for the first 5 minutes, which would put a solo visit near 45%, but flags that as unconfirmed.

disclosures.title: expect a long grind
disclosures.body: Reports run from 15 kills in about 30 hours for one set to 130+ missions without the blueprint. Each member drops one of mod, blueprint or resource per kill, not all three.

disclosures.title: unreachable spawns and bugs
disclosures.body: They can spawn in unreachable areas after elevator or door triggers, which kills them and wastes the drops. Appearing in Survival can stop the 5-minute rewards; Interception and Defense can bug out.
